title: Veterans' Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2022
official_summary:
Veterans' Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2022

This act requires the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to increase the amounts payable for wartime disability compensation, additional compensation for dependents, the clothing allowance for certain disabled veterans, and dependency and indemnity compensation for surviving spouses and children. Specifically, the VA must increase the amounts by the same percentage as the cost-of-living increase in benefits for Social Security recipients that is effective on December 1, 2022. The act requires the VA to publish the amounts payable, as increased, in the Federal Register.

The VA is authorized to make a similar adjustment to the rates of disability compensation payable to persons who have not received compensation for service-connected disability or death.

summary.headline: A 2022 law requires the VA to raise several veterans and survivor benefit payments by the same percentage as the Social Security cost-of-living increase effective December 1, 2022.
summary.what_it_does: The law requires the Department of Veterans Affairs to increase wartime disability compensation, additional compensation for dependents, the clothing allowance for certain disabled veterans, and dependency and indemnity compensation for surviving spouses and children. The increase uses the same percentage as the Social Security cost-of-living adjustment that takes effect December 1, 2022. The VA must publish the new amounts in the Federal Register. The VA may also make a similar adjustment to disability compensation rates for people who have not received compensation for a service-connected disability or death.

who_it_affects.how: Their monthly wartime disability payments are required to increase by the Social Security cost-of-living percentage.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans with dependents who receive additional compensation
who_it_affects.how: The extra payments they get for dependents are required to increase by the same percentage.

who_it_affects.group: Certain disabled veterans receiving the clothing allowance
who_it_affects.how: The clothing allowance amount is required to increase by the same percentage.

who_it_affects.group: Surviving spouses and children receiving dependency and indemnity compensation
who_it_affects.how: Their survivor payments are required to increase by the same percentage.

who_it_affects.group: Veterans and survivors not currently receiving service-connected disability or death compensation
who_it_affects.how: The VA is allowed, but not required, to make a similar rate adjustment for them.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The increases take effect with the Social Security cost-of-living adjustment effective December 1, 2022.
